sourceNote: Live official wiki raw wikitext (Lua Module:Missions/data), fetched 2026-08-31 through a browser session (Cloudflare blocks plain HTTP clients). MissionDetails held 357 entries; 2 were omitted for having no InternalName ("Lunaro Arena", "Phorid Alert"). NextNodes/PreviousNodes display names were resolved to InternalNames via the Name->InternalName map from the same table; all resolved, none dropped. Junction nodes carry type "Solar Rail Junction"; their 13 edges match the post-Update 39 (Isleweaver) topology. Mars Junction has no NextNodes in the source, so its next[] is empty. Two InternalNames are shared by two entries each in the source (not a parse artifact): "ToggleBootLevel" (Drifter's Camp / The Orbiter) and "SolNode236" (The Duviri Experience / Isleweaver); all four are edgeless, so keying by id must tolerate these collisions.
